name: Activate a subordinate HQ or Staff
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: CO HQ: Any subordinate HQ or Staff; BN HQ: CO HQ only
details: Both the Originator and the Recipient must be on their command sides (1.2.3B, 3.3.1). Only the BN HQ can Activate the CO HQ. Only the CO HQ can Activate PLT HQs or CO Staff. Flip the Command marker of the Activated HQ to its Commands Available side.
recipient_type: CO HQ: Any subordinate HQ or Staff; BN HQ: CO HQ only

name: Exhort¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: A unit that just failed an attempt
details: You can declare this action once for any failed attempt. Draw one more Action card.
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: A unit that just failed an attempt

name: Deploy Pyrotechnic
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: Any Good Order unit or Unpinned Assault Team / Fire Team unit with a pyrotechnic asset
details: Take the asset from Command Display or from under a unit stacked with it and flip it to its deployed side on the same card (or adjacent card for aerial devices) as the unit deploying it. If there is an action associated with that device on the Mission Log, then perform or attempt all triggered actions (4.4.1 and 9.2).
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit or Unpinned Assault Team / Fire Team unit with a pyrotechnic asset

name: Reconstitute a PLT HQ¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: CO Staff or Any Good Order unit from that platoon
details: Reduce the Recipient by one step or remove the CO Staff unit, and place the PLT HQ back into play on that card at a Green Experience Level (6.5.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: CO Staff or Any Good Order unit from that platoon

name: Reconstitute the CO HQ¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: Eligible HQ or Staff
details: You may reconstitute the CO HQ from its second-in-command (i.e. the XO). If the XO has already been Removed from Play, use one of the following units in this order of precedence: any Platoon HQ, Arty FO, CO Staff (in rank order) (6.5.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: Eligible HQ or Staff

name: Create a Runner¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: Any Good Order unit or Unpinned Assault Team / Fire Team
details: Reduce the Recipient by one step and place a Line rated Runner in the CO HQ Assets box on the Command Display. You can have no more than two Runners in play at any given time (4.3.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit or Unpinned Assault Team / Fire Team

name: Dispatch a Runner¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: A Runner unit in the CO HQ Assets box
details: Place the Runner on the map on a card with any PLT HQ or CO Staff unit on the map that you want to Activate next turn. Mark the Runner as Exposed (4.3.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: A Runner unit in the CO HQ Assets box

name: Dismiss a Runner¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: A Good Order Runner unit
details: Remove the Runner from play and add a step to a Good Order unit that can absorb at least one step and that is located on the same area of a card as the CO HQ (4.3.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: A Good Order Runner unit

name: Activate for AT Combat & Vehicle Movement
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: Any vehicle or Unpinned AT-capable infantry unit
details: Mark the unit as Activated. During the AT Combat & Vehicle Movement Phase you may have the unit take Vehicle Actions (AT Fire, Vehicle movement, etc.) (10.5).
recipient_type: Any vehicle or Unpinned AT-capable infantry unit

name: Switch Radio/Phone to a Different Network
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
recipient: A unit with a radio or phone
details: Replace the same kind of radio or phone with one that has been Removed from Play. For example, if the SCR300 BN TAC radio has been destroyed, you could switch the SCR300 Mtr FD NET radio with the SCR300 BN TAC radio (4.3.4 and 4.3.5).

name: Repair a Cut Phone Line
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
originator: Any HQ or Staff on the same card as the cut line
recipient: A Good Order unit on the same card as a cut phone line
details: Flip the phone line marker back to its normal side (4.3.4).

name: Designate a New Tactical Control¹
draw_modifier_rule: N/A
originator: CO HQ or CO Staff (or PLT HQ in a single-platoon mission)
recipient: The HQ itself
details: Place a new tactical control measure on the same card as the HQ that expends the Command (see 5.1.7 for Casualty Collection Point and MEDEVAC LZ; see 11.1.3 for Landing Zones).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: The HQ itself

name: Move to an Adjacent Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed
details: Move the unit to an adjacent card and mark it as Exposed. If there is a Cover marker on that card, you may place the unit under that Cover marker. Do not mark a unit as Exposed if it moves from under a Trench, Bunker or Pillbox Cover marker on the first card, to one of those markers on the second card (5.1.2), or moves between Attached Buildings on two Urban Terrain cards (13.7).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5). | ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed

name: Move a Platoon to an Adjacent Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card that are not marked as Exposed
details: Have each unit in the platoon perform a Move to an Adjacent Card action (5.1.2). All units move to the same card. (Units on the card who are out of communication with the Originator remain in place.)
footnotes: ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card that are not marked as Exposed

name: Attempt to Infiltrate an Adjacent Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed, and that does not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating
details: Either the origin card or the intended destination card must have a VOF marker on it in order to use this action. Draw Action cards and check for the Infiltrate icon. If it is present, then the attempt succeeds; move the unit to the adjacent card but do not mark it as Exposed. If there is cover on that card, you may place the unit under a Cover marker. If the attempt fails, perform a regular Move to an Adjacent card action to the original intended destination card (5.1.4).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5). | ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed, and that does not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating

name: Attempt to have a Platoon Infiltrate an Adjacent Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card that are not marked as Exposed and that do not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating
details: Have each unit in the platoon perform an Attempt to Infiltrate an Adjacent Card action (5.1.4). All units move to the same card. (Units on the card who are out of communication with the Originator remain in place.)
footnotes: ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card that are not marked as Exposed and that do not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating

name: Attempt to Seek Cover²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹ on a card that has not reached its Cover Potential and is not under a Cover marker
details: Draw Action cards equal to the Cover Draw number on the unit’s card and check for the word “Cover.” If it is present, then the attempt succeeds; place the unit under a new Cover marker and mark it as Exposed. If the attempt fails, do nothing (5.1.1).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5). | ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit¹ on a card that has not reached its Cover Potential and is not under a Cover marker

name: Move within a Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹
details: Place the unit in the desired area of its card (under a Cover marker, out-of-cover, a separate area of an Urban Terrain card, etc.) and mark it as Exposed (5.1.1).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5). | ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit¹

name: Attempt to Infiltrate within a Card²
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed and that does not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating
details: Requires a VOF marker on the card. Draw Action cards and check for the Infiltrate icon. If the icon is present, then the attempt succeeds; place the unit in the desired area of its card (under a Cover marker, out-of-cover area, etc.). If the attempt fails, perform a regular Move within a Card action (5.1.4). Note: Not available on Urban Terrain cards (13.2.1).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5). | ² Cannot be used by units noted on the Vehicle and Anti-Tank Weapons Chart as being “Immobile” while on their Good Order Side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit¹ not marked as Exposed and that does not have a tripod symbol or an H VOF rating

name: Pick up, load, unload, embark
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit¹
details: Have an infantry unit pick up items from the card or from a different unit, or load/unload items on/off a vehicle, or embark on a vehicle. Or have a vehicle embark all infantry units, casualties and load/unload any items in their card area. Mark any infantry units involved Exposed (5.1.6). Note: Dropping items can be carried out without an action (5.1.6B) and Disembarking is carried out as part of vehicle Actions (10.2.2).
footnotes: ¹ Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5).

name: Attempt to Remove a Pinned marker
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any unit under a Pinned marker
details: If the Recipient’s card has any VOF marker on it, draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; remove the Pinned marker. If the attempt fails, do nothing. If there is no VOF marker on the card then the action is automatically successful (6.5.1).
recipient_type: Any unit under a Pinned marker

name: Attempt to Convert a Paralyzed Team to a Litter Team
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Unpinned Paralyzed Team
details: If the Recipient’s card has any VOF marker on it, draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; exchange the Paralyzed Team for a Litter Team. If the attempt fails, do nothing. If there is no VOF marker on the card then the action is automatically successful (6.5.1).
recipient_type: Any Unpinned Paralyzed Team

name: Attempt to Convert a Litter Team to a Fire Team
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Unpinned Litter Team
details: If the Recipient’s card has any VOF marker on it, draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; exchange the Litter Team for a Fire Team. If the attempt fails, do nothing. If there is no VOF marker on the card then the action is automatically successful (6.5.1).
recipient_type: Any Unpinned Litter Team

name: Attempt to Convert a Fire Team to an Assault Team
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Unpinned Fire Team
details: If the Recipient’s card has any VOF marker on it, draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; exchange the Fire Team for an Assault Team. If the attempt fails, do nothing. If there is no VOF marker on the card then the action is automatically successful (6.5.1).
recipient_type: Any Unpinned Fire Team

name: Convert an Assault Team to a Fire Team
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Unpinned Assault Team
details: Replace the Assault Team with a Fire Team.
recipient_type: Any Unpinned Assault Team

name: Attempt to Flip a unit with a Fire Team Side to Front
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Unpinned named Fire Team (including originator HQ itself)
details: If the Recipient’s card has any VOF marker on it, draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; flip the Fire Team side back to its Good Order side. If the attempt fails, do nothing. If there is no VOF marker on the card then the action is automatically successful (6.5.1).
recipient_type: Any Unpinned named Fire Team (including originator HQ itself)

name: Detach Team
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order 3-4 step squad or 2-step weapons team
details: Reduce the squad or weapons team by a step and place either an Assault or Fire Team into play on the card. Transfer any assets to the detached team as desired. Two-step squads may not split into two teams with this action.
recipient_type: Any Good Order 3-4 step squad or 2-step weapons team

name: Supplement Squad
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order 2-3 step squad and an Unpinned Fire or Assault Team
details: Remove the Team from play and add the step to the squad.
recipient_type: Any Good Order 2-3 step squad and an Unpinned Fire or Assault Team

name: Attempt to Reconstitute Squad¹
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: 2 to 4 Unpinned Assault or Fire Teams
details: Draw Action cards and check for the word “Rally.” If Rally is drawn, then the attempt succeeds; remove the 2 to 4 Teams and replace them with a squad with an equal number of steps that has previously been removed from play. If the attempt fails, do nothing (6.5.2).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
recipient_type: 2 to 4 Unpinned Assault or Fire Teams

name: Flip a unit with a Fire Team side to its Fire Team side
draw_modifier_rule: Use Originator's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit with a Fire Team side
details: Flip the unit from its Good Order side to its Fire Team side.
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit with a Fire Team side

name: Attempt to Spot
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit² with LOS to an Unspotted enemy
details: Draw Action cards, modified by the Spotting modifiers on the Spotting Attempt Draw Modifiers Chart, and check for the Crosshairs icon. If the icon is present, then the attempt succeeds; remove any marker being used to indicate an Unspotted unit. If the attempt fails, do nothing (8.5).
footnotes: ² Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5).
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit² with LOS to an Unspotted enemy

name: Attempt to Concentrate Fire
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order S, A, A/S or H VOF rated unit² projecting a VOF onto a card with Spotted enemy units
details: Select either a stack of units under a cover marker or one random unit out of cover as the target. Draw Action cards and check for the Crosshairs icon. If the icon is present, then the attempt succeeds; place a Concentrated Fire marker on the target unit. If the unit tracks ammo, it expends 2 instead of 1 ammo point. If the attempt fails, do nothing (7.11).
footnotes: ² Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5).
recipient_type: Any Good Order S, A, A/S or H VOF rated unit² projecting a VOF onto a card with Spotted enemy units

name: Attempt to have a Platoon Concentrate Fire
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: All Good Order S, A, A/S or H VOF rated units of that platoon on the same card who are projecting a VOF onto a card with Spotted enemy units
details: Select either a stack of units under a cover marker or the “out of cover” area as the target. Have each unit make an Attempt to Concentrate Fire on the target. Each successful attempt in the “out of cover” area is placed on one random unit (7.11).
recipient_type: All Good Order S, A, A/S or H VOF rated units of that platoon on the same card who are projecting a VOF onto a card with Spotted enemy units

name: Attempt to make a Grenade Attack
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any Good Order unit²
details: Select either a stack of units under a cover marker or a single unit out of cover as the target. Draw Action cards and check for the Grenade icon. If the icon is present, then the attempt succeeds; place a Grenade VOF marker on the target. If the attempt fails, place a Grenade Miss Modifier on the card. The targeted units may make a free Grenade Attack in response (7.10).
footnotes: ² Also available to Pinned units and some LATs with restrictions (4.2.5).
recipient_type: Any Good Order unit²

name: Attempt to Throw a Demolition Charge
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any demo-capable unit with a demolition charge
details: Draw Action cards and check for the Grenade icon. If the icon is present, then the attempt succeeds; place a Demo Attack VOF marker on the target. If the attempt fails, place a Demo Miss Modifier on the card (7.13).
recipient_type: Any demo-capable unit with a demolition charge

name: Place a Demolition Charge
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any demo-capable unit with a demolition charge not under a VOF
details: Place a Demo Attack VOF marker on the target (7.13).
recipient_type: Any demo-capable unit with a demolition charge not under a VOF

name: Flamethrower Attack
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any unit with a flamethrower
details: Place a Flame Attack VOF marker on the target (7.14).
recipient_type: Any unit with a flamethrower

name: Attempt to have a Platoon make a Grenade Attack
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card
details: Select a single unit out of cover or one stack of units under a cover marker as the target. Have each unit carry out an Attempt to make a Grenade Attack on the target.
recipient_type: All Good Order units of that platoon on the same card

name: Attempt to Call for Fire from an Off-Map Firing Agency (includes Air Strikes and Attack Helicopters)
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any eligible observer per mission instructions
details: Draw a number of Action cards per the mission instructions (modified by Experience) and check for the Burst icon (Draw an extra Action card if the fire is Registered according to 7.16.5). If the icon is present and the Call for Fire prerequisites are met (7.16.1), then the attempt succeeds; expend an available Fire Mission on the Mission Log and place a Pending Fire Mission marker on the target card (7.16).

name: Call for Indirect Fire from an On-Map Mortar
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any On-Map Mortar unit
details: Place the appropriate VOF marker on any Spotted enemy card in the Originator’s LOS and in range of the firing mortar. The firing mortar unit must have at least two steps. The mortar unit expends ammo (7.3.2).
recipient_type: Any On-Map Mortar unit

name: Cease Fire
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any unit in communication exerting a VOF regardless of the chain of command
details: Remove the VOF/PDF generated by all occupants of the card. Once the order is given, it is passed on and carried out by all units on the card whether they are in communication or not. Note that units will immediately Open Fire automatically on enemies in LOS (6.3.3).
recipient_type: Any unit in communication exerting a VOF regardless of the chain of command

name: Shift Fire
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: Any unit in communication exerting a VOF regardless of the chain of command
details: Move the VOF/PDF in any desired direction, engaging any other eligible card in the Originator’s LOS, including an unoccupied card (but not one with Unspotted opposing units). Once the order is given, it is passed on and carried out by all units on the card whether they are in communication or not (6.1).
recipient_type: Any unit in communication exerting a VOF regardless of the chain of command

name: Fire FPF/FPL¹
draw_modifier_rule: Use Recipient's Experience Level for Command draw modifier
recipient: FPL: Good order unit with FPL marker. FPF: Self
details: For an FPF, place a Pending Fire Mission marker on the FPF marker’s card (7.16.2D). For an FPL, place a Heavy Weapons VOF marker along all cards in LOS in the direction shown by the arrow on the FPL marker (7.2.4).
footnotes: ¹ Requires an Originator HQ/Staff to order even if carried out in General Initiative (4.1.3).
